title: Context length silently limited to 255 bytes
close_reason: The 255-byte context limit in kdf.rs is intentional and sufficient. Context buffers (build_context_2/3 in transcript.rs) are heapless::Vec<u8, 128> - max 128 bytes. The KDF info buffer is also 128 bytes, so context cannot exceed ~125 bytes. EDHOC contexts (transcript hashes, credentials, connection IDs) never approach 255 bytes. The cbor.rs module already has 2-byte length encoding (0x59) if ever needed. This is appropriate protocol bounds, not a bug requiring implementation.
